description_en: Creates a user group for a bastion host
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-name group --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host for which you want to create a user group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
要新建用户组的堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to create a user group.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要新建用户组的堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the user group that you want to create. This name can be a up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 要新建的用户组的名称。最多支持128字符
parameters.name: user_group_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the user group. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 新建的用户组的备注信息。最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

UserGroupId.description_en: The ID of the user group
